segments.title: How long is ONE DAY on Mars?
segments.say: How long is one day on Mars? Comment your answer. Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Just over 24 hours!
segments.sub: **24 h 39 min** for a full day
segments.say: Just over twenty four hours! About twenty four hours and thirty nine minutes.

segments.title: It's called a SOL
segments.say: A Mars day is called a sol, about forty minutes longer than ours.

segments.title: But a Mars YEAR? 687 days
segments.say: But a Mars year lasts six hundred eighty seven days.
